text: 中国人民银行召开2026年下半年工作会议。会议强调，加快金融市场建设发展。加强制度机制建设，完善金融市场宏观审慎管理指标体系，探索丰富金融市场宏观审慎管理工具箱，健全金融基础设施制度规则和治理体系，加强金融市场运行状况的监测、评估。强化金融市场执法，严厉打击违法违规行为，维护金融市场秩序。稳步推进金融市场高水平开放，优化债券通双向开放机制，有序推进境内外基础设施合作，丰富流动性管理和风险对冲工具。（央行）
text_en: The People's Bank of China held its H2 2026 work conference. The meeting emphasized accelerating financial market development. Institutional mechanisms will be strengthened, macroprudential management indicator systems for financial markets improved, macroprudential management toolkits explored and enriched, financial infrastructure rules and governance systems perfected, and monitoring and evaluation of financial market operations enhanced. Financial market enforcement will be intensified, with severe crackdowns on violations to maintain market order. High-level opening of financial markets will be steadily advanced, the Bond Connect two-way opening mechanism optimized, domestic and overseas infrastructure cooperation promoted in an orderly manner, and liquidity management and risk hedging tools enriched. (PBOC)
